Floor reflections blend away softly, never ending in a hard line. Every screen and lightbox is a real commercial unit with real thickness, a slim frame and real fixings, lit like a real panel, never a flat glowing shape pasted on the wall. Ordinary real public-building materials only: tile, terrazzo, pale stone, glass and brushed steel; nothing unusual, luxurious or over the top.
